text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important choices. When building an app, developers must think about responsive design so it works well on different screen sizes. They also decide between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, like iOS or Android, and often run faster. Cross-platform apps work on both systems with one codebase, which saves time and money. After development, apps are published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store so users can download them. Finally, performance matters a lot. A fast, smooth app keeps users happy, while a slow one is quickly deleted.
